title: TE Connectivity
summary: Swiss-American connector and sensor group serving aerospace, automotive and data centres.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

TE Connectivity makes connectors, relays, sensors and cable assemblies for vehicles, aircraft, satellites and data centres. Its aerospace and defence business supplies harsh-environment interconnects used in launch and satellite systems. The company is also a major supplier of high-speed connectors for AI data-centre hardware.

Technology Exposure

  • Aerospace and defence connectors
  • High-speed data-centre interconnects
  • Automotive sensors and connectors

What To Watch

  • Aerospace build rates
  • AI data-centre demand
  • Automotive production

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
